title.en: An Act Declaring October Twenty of Every Year as Adlaw Sa Ormoc, a Special Nonworking Public Holiday for the City of Ormoc

text.en: October 20 of every year is hereby declared as Adlaw sa Ormoc, a special nonworking public holiday for the City of Ormoc, Province of Leyte.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
